notes.title: 2024 Autumn - New 5 Songs Arrived
notes.notes:
Hello, this is joversound.
I'm here with the update after a long time.


[b]1. New musics[/b]

(Really surprisingly) It contains the following five new pieces.
Thank you very much to the composers who allowed me to use the song.

[b]PYKAMIA - Spirito dell'acqua
SIHanatsuka - Vortex
LOFTIER - Tenebris
Templat - Gradatim
iTIC - Invisible Dragon[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44855357/69a13937f3cfe36a1d281292d1c6ce136c4bc95e.jpg[/img]

As the existing game lacked a difficulty ladder, I tried to organize it with a rather easier and gentle patterns.


2. In-game key exposure

Added a function to display operation keys around the purification stone.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44855357/03fedf1d5b6c79af748affb616cbda19491a3be4.gif[/img]

How to use: Settings > Input > In-game Key Exposure > On

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44855357/13125d5f3c47ecf0cd80b477320d369fdbb56c74.gif[/img]


3. Pattern Correction

Some sections of Nyarlathotep's Dreamland (NORMAL 14, HARD 16) that were deemed unreasonably difficult have been fixed to make it easier to hit than before.
It hasn't changed much enough to affect the difficulty.

Example: 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44855357/243cb9c9088ca81924af2d7797d9d142f39b5a39.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44855357/0347eac30c8376e038ba103bb6481290004d6f86.jpg[/img][/url]


4. Adjust Difficulty Indication

I have changed the difficulty mark of the patterns that feel particularly difficult due to the use of the top of the circle.

414 PER SPEED (Easy 5 → 6)
Nyarlathotep's Dreamland (Easy 7 → 8)

During the development period, my skills have improved so much that it is hard to estimate the difficulty...
If you think that a correction is needed, feel free to request it and I will reflect it as much as possible.


5. Other modifications

- You can go directly to the song you want with the top button of the song selection screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44855357/b8feaf19c5761dad44ebf1d7d0021d04d3449f57.gif[/img]

- When setting the offset automatically, the volume of sound played has been greatly increased.
- Fixed an error where the leaderboard was displayed inappropriately when a lot of songs are changed fast.
- Fixed a bug of incorrect letter position for long/long-hold note after setting judgment marking location as above judgment line.
- Fixed a bug in which the octagonal border of note was not intermittently revealed.

Hello, this is joversound.
After a long time, there are two updates.


1. Steam Cloud

I encountered cases of sadness because the records were not linked, so I added the function even though it was late.
Since the game has already been released, there may be people who have different play data on various devices.
Because of this, I was concerned about the possibility of losing records, so I made players choose their own data move commands within the game.

Click main screen > Steam Cloud.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44855357/bf9ace8d49bd964bd722c30c486581e5caaf6ae6.png[/img]

By clicking on the arrow, you can link your device's data to Steam or overwrite the steam's data to your device.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44855357/f1525402df5ba2c7ee3a8352ad613642c932f048.png[/img]



2. Leaderboard

The score and name of the first to third place will now be displayed on the song selection screen, and you can also check the rest of the rankings in the community.
The data has been collected since the last update (2024-04-28).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44855357/c786b84bd1c7dce1fc529ef5506740ed37a552f9.png[/img]




Please understand that the service was not provided in a timely manner because I didn't even know how to implement it at the time of launch.
I am learning hard.. Thank you.

It's my fault, so I'll just leave those who have already accomplished it...

Hello, this is joversound. I had some free time after the midterm exams, so I fixed the game a little bit.

1. Added achievements. However, I didn't meet the qualifications of the profile function because the sales are 0$ and it doesn't count towards the total number of achievements for the user because of those restrictions. I'd appreciate it if you could still enjoy it because it feels just good to accomplish it.
- 3 Play Results (Cleared, Full Combo, All Perfect)
- 6 Score Ranks (D, C, B, A, S, L)
- 9 types of music (based on the total score of the song)
- 4 types of progress (based on the total score of all songs)
- ???

2. Renewed the two illustrations more dynamically. Compared to the music, it feels like I drew too roughly.
- Broken Altair
- Nyarlathotep's Dreamland

3. Changed the camera movement of some of the songs. There was no change in the pattern.
- Teardrop del Rey
- GIFT
- Broken Altair (EASY)
- Nyarlathotep's Dreamland

4. Other fixes
- Added effects to highlight the tab within the settings window, the main options on the current tab, and the difficulty button on the selecting screen.
- If you have a different customization of the purification stone and note, you will receive a warning message.
- Additional comments have been added to the tutorial.
- Modified the information on the store page.

Added offset setup function.
You can now set the value more intuitively.

notes.title: Tutorial Bug Fixed Again
notes.notes: In the basic tutorial, a bug has been fixed in which summoning a certain number of long notes will continue to generate long notes with a length of 0 afterward.

notes.title: Resolution Bug / Tutorial Bug Fixed
notes.notes:
- A bug has been fixed in which the resolution of the main screen is incorrectly applied when changing the resolution of the screen.
- A bug has been fixed that when you mouse click the tutorial selection button, in any case, runs only 'basic-simply' tutorial.

notes.title: Tutorial Bug Fixed
notes.notes:
[b]Bug where notes are generated too quickly in tutorials was fixed.[/b]

In tutorials, the lower the note speed, the faster the note was set up. So there was no problem with setting the note speed high, but at the default note speed of 2.0/2.0, the note was created right in front of the judgment line. Sorry for the inconvenience from the start of the game because I didn't test it in various situations.
